messages:
lauren: Heads-up — we need to re-scope Payments MVP for the pilot. Infra delay + pilot constraints mean we should trim two items and move one to v1. Proposal: cut instant-refund + multi-merchant routing from MVP, keep card-on-file and retry logic. Shift canary by 2 weeks?
ishaan: Which features specifically and what happens to resources?
lauren: Cut list: `instant-refund`, `multi-merchant-routing`. Move `multi-merchant-routing` to v1. Rationale: pilot customers don't need multi-merchant and instant-refund touches async billing queues (higher infra risk).
tess: UX note — removing instant-refund simplifies flows, less edge-copy. I can update billing flows and banner copy quickly.
omar: Dev impact: cutting instant-refund saves ~1 GPU-week of infra/testing time. We still need 2 engs for gateway integration. If we can free Sasha from infra for 2 sprints, frontend is covered.
chris: From QA/telemetry: removing multi-merchant drops routing permutations by ~40%, end-to-end tests around routing go down ~18% effort. Good for faster canary.
lauren: Proposed timeline change: original canary `2029-05-01` -> proposed `2029-05-15`. Also need a short exec summary for Monday. Thoughts?
ishaan: May 15 ok if QA runs smoke tests in parallel with infra work. I'll sketch a parallel QA plan and signoff gates.
tess: I'll have updated wires + copy by EOD tomorrow and a small banner variant for the pilot.
omar: I'll request Sasha's temporary reassignment with engineering manager. @lauren can you confirm so I can ping people-ops?
lauren: Confirmed — go ahead and request reassignment. I'll follow up with people-ops and update the roadmap.
deploy-bot: reminder: deploy freeze window `2029-04-28` -> `2029-05-02`. Avoid major infra changes then.
lauren: Noted. We'll avoid deploy during freeze. If a pilot asks for multi-merchant, fallback is `single-merchant + manual reconciliation` — acceptable short-term?
chris: Acceptable. Log an action to add reconciliation checklist to onboarding docs and telemetry.
ishaan: I'll draft a short playbook for the fallback and post as a PR to the docs repo.
lauren: Decision summary: proceed with the two cuts, move multi-merchant to v1, shift canary to `2029-05-15`. I'll prepare the exec summary and post in Monday sync. :thumbsup:
